result.topic_en: A second check of a previously computed value A: multiplying A by 59·10^9, factoring the nearby integer 254962178 = 54·13·3631939, factoring 3631939 = 1091·3329 via representations by the form 40x^2+19y^2, and a high-precision logarithmic computation of 59A = N e^δ.

methods.what: Verification of a computed constant by scaling it to near an integer and factoring that integer
methods.quote:
multiplicirte man, nach einigen andern vergeblichen Versuchen, den nur gefundenen Werth von A mit $59.10^9$ woraus entstand
$254962177,5625...$

Die Zahl $254962178$ zerfiel in die Factoren
$54.13.3631939$.

methods.what: Factoring a number from two distinct representations by the quadratic form 40x^2+19y^2
Expressing 59A as a rational number times an exponential of a sum of logarithms and π, computed via high-precision log tables
Splitting the exponent δ using -log(1-10^{-7}·157) and computing e^δ to high precision

items.quote: Um die Richtigkeit dieser ersten Rechnung durch eine zweite zu bestättigen
items.english: In order to confirm the correctness of this first calculation by a second one
